title: amico vault card (distillation-pass contract)
description: The card frontmatter contract for knowledge-plane vault residents (#496, spec-20260821-090401 'Card Families' + amendments 1–2). Eighteen card types: the 12 schema-check types (extended with OPTIONAL provenance/confidence/review_by/subject fields — a legacy card with none of them validates unchanged; the census stamps them later), the 4 memory families (feedback/project/reference/user — the amicode/memory/ filename-typed cards, typed), plus tension and tombstone. Plane residency (amendment 2): knowledge/ residents are CARDS (this schema); evidence/ residents are RECORDS (vault-record.schema.json — type/date/origin only); work/ residents are working documents outside card machinery. The RESIDENCY table is exported from src/vault-card.ts (PLANE_RESIDENCY) and documented in test/fixtures/vault-cards/README.md. Discriminated on `type` via oneOf — external tools may validate with any JSON Schema implementation; amicode's validateVaultCard() dispatches on `type` for field-precise errors.

confidence.description: the census default is medium; the extension field reuses the same vocabulary the insight base type already carries
